tokens.npc_dota_hero_enchantress_bio:
Aiushtha appears to be an innocent, carefree creature of the woods, and while this is certainly true, it is hardly the sum of her story. She well understands the suffering of the natural world. She has wandered far, and fared through forests bright and drear, in every clime and every season, gathering friends, sharing news, bringing laughter and healing wherever she goes. For in worlds wracked by war, forests are leveled for the building of ships and siege engines; and even in places of peace, the woods are stripped for the building of homes, and as fuel for countless hearths.

Aiushtha hears the pleas of the small creatures, the furtive folk who need green shade and a leafy canopy to thrive. She lends her ears to those who have no other listeners. She carries their stories from the wood to the world, believing that her own good cheer is a kind of Enchantment, that can itself fulfill the promise of a verdant future.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_enchantress_hype: Harmful up close and lethal at a distance, Enchantress skewers foes with attacks imbued to become more damaging the further they fly. Whether inflicting powerful slows on her enemies or charming forest creatures to fight her battles, she is never short of tools to win a fight.

*** {{U|Siege Creep|text=Siege creeps}}.
*** All sources of {{U|Necronomicon Archer|text=Necronomicon Archers}} and {{U|Necronomicon Warrior|text=Necronomicon Warriors}}.
*** Cannot Enchant already {{A|Enchantress|Enchant|text=Enchanted}} creeps of the same {{M|faction}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|enchantress_enchant_slow}}
*** Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration.
*** Affects {{M|Couriers}}, but does nothing.

*** {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Applies the following effects when cast on <ab>Enchantress Enchant 2.mp3</ab> enemy heroes:
***** The {{M|movement speed}} slow.

data.bio_loc:
Aiushtha appears to be an innocent, carefree creature of the woods, and while this is certainly true, it is hardly the sum of her story. She well understands the suffering of the natural world. She has wandered far, and fared through forests bright and drear, in every clime and every season, gathering friends, sharing news, bringing laughter and healing wherever she goes. For in worlds wracked by war, forests are leveled for the building of ships and siege engines; and even in places of peace, the woods are stripped for the building of homes, and as fuel for countless hearths.

Aiushtha hears the pleas of the small creatures, the furtive folk who need green shade and a leafy canopy to thrive. She lends her ears to those who have no other listeners. She carries their stories from the wood to the world, believing that her own good cheer is a kind of Enchantment, that can itself fulfill the promise of a verdant future.
data.hype_loc: Harmful up close and lethal at a distance, Enchantress skewers foes with attacks imbued to become more damaging the further they fly. Whether inflicting powerful slows on her enemies or charming forest creatures to fight her battles, she is never short of tools to win a fight.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s.
